veranderings.voor: Koue kom nie by jou hand in nie, en net hitte beweeg.
veranderings.na: Koue kom nie by jou hand in nie. Net hitte beweeg.
veranderings.rede: The second clause contrasts with the first, so 'en' joins them weakly; two short sentences state the contrast more clearly.

veranderings.voor: die magneet trek die spyker aan en die draad glad nie
veranderings.na: die magneet trek die spyker aan, maar glad nie die draad nie
veranderings.rede: The elliptical 'en die draad glad nie' is incomplete; a contrast with 'maar' and the full negative frame reads naturally.

veranderings.voor: Om metaal te wees beteken dus nie om magneties te wees nie
veranderings.na: Nie alle metale is dus magneties nie
veranderings.rede: The infinitive construction is wooden for Grade 5; the plain sentence says the same thing.

veranderings.na: en 'n krap in die verf laat die staal
veranderings.rede: Says where the scratch is, so the learner links it to the paint in the previous clause; nothing new is added.
